blurb: Denver Dance Starz offers dance classes for children ages 2 to 18 in tap, jazz, hip hop, ballet, lyrical, pom, and creative movement. They provide recreation level classes, weekly classes, and themed summer camps. Classes culminate in performances such as a winter show and summer recital.
extraNote: $25 family registration fee due at time of registration · $50 deposit per camp session required at registration, applied to total fee · Minimum 3 participants required for camp sessions or session cancelled and deposit refunded · Tuition due on the first of the month, fees not prorated
